task_grounding:
Open OBS Studio and set up a scene collection with multiple scenes and sources.

1. OBS may start with a default 'Scene' -- you can rename it or delete it.
2. Create three scenes with the exact names: 'Intro', 'Main Content', 'Outro'.
3. Select the 'Intro' scene. Add a new source of type 'Color Source' (sometimes called 'Color Bar' or similar) and name it exactly 'Background'.
4. Select the 'Main Content' scene. Add a new source of type 'Display Capture' (or 'Screen Capture') and name it exactly 'Desktop'.
5. The 'Outro' scene can remain empty (no sources needed).
6. Make sure all added sources are visible (eye icon enabled).
7. Close OBS or let it auto-save. The scene collection is saved automatically to ~/.config/obs-studio/basic/scenes/.

The final scene collection should have exactly 3 scenes: 'Intro', 'Main Content', and 'Outro'. Remove any extra default scenes if present.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use 'scene list' to find index, then 'source set --name new-name' to rename
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI can rename scenes and sources using 'source set --name new-name' command
